newsitem.title: USA: NY Mayor offers London woman City Hall wedding.
newsitem.headline: NY Mayor offers London woman City Hall wedding.

text.p: Mayor Rudolph Giuliani surprised a London woman who wanted her Irish father to see her married on St Patrick's Day in New York by inviting her family to a City Hall wedding.

Giuliani made the offer on his monthly WCBS local radio programme "Ask The Mayor" on Thursday night after Davina Ismail Massey sent an electronic mail message to the station saying she was having difficulty arranging a March wedding at City Hall.

Producers called Massey while the Mayor was on the air. When Giuliani asked her why she wanted her wedding in New York, Massey said, "Well, my father's Irish and he's never been to America and I think he ought to get there."
Giuliani, more accustomed to answering questions about local politics and other civic issues on the programme, said, "I would be happy to help you to get married. Would you like to do that?"
Massey, laughing over the trans-Atlantic telephone line, replied, "That would be amazing."
Giuliani invited the couple to the annual St Patrick's Day breakfast at his official Gracie Mansion residence on March 17 and said he would officiate the wedding at City Hall.
